name: Sarah Nakato
bio: BSc Computer Science, Makerere University. Works at a fintech company in Kampala building mobile money integrations for SACCOs and village banks across Uganda.

name: James Okello
bio: MBChB, Mbarara University of Science and Technology. Intern at Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital, hoping to specialize in paediatrics and serve in upcountry health centres.

name: Grace Nabukenya
bio: Bachelor of Arts with Education, Makerere University. Teaches Literature and English at a secondary school in Wakiso. Runs a debate club and mentors girls in leadership.

name: David Ssemakula
bio: Runs a coffee and vanilla farming cooperative in Kassanda District with over 40 smallholder farmers. Exports to specialty buyers in Europe. Based in Kiganda, near the school.

name: Rita Achieng
bio: BSc Civil Engineering, Kyambogo University. Works with a construction firm on road and bridge projects in northern Uganda.

name: Peter Mugisha
bio: Works in corporate banking at a leading Ugandan bank. Handles SME lending and has helped several former students secure startup capital.

name: Agnes Kirabo
bio: Diploma in Nursing, Mulago School of Nursing. Works at Jinja Regional Referral Hospital. Leads a community health outreach program in rural Busoga.

name: Moses Wasswa
bio: LLB Makerere, Postgraduate Diploma in Legal Practice, LDC. Runs a private practice in Kampala focusing on land and family law. Enrolled as an Advocate of the High Court of Uganda.

name: Esther Namuli
bio: Studied Statistics at Makerere, then relocated to Dubai. Works as a data analyst in the retail sector. Sends remittances home and helps fund former students' school fees.

name: Joseph Kato
bio: Owns a tour company based in Fort Portal specialising in crater lakes, Kibale chimpanzee tracking, and Rwenzori foothill treks. Employs local guides and porters.

name: Brenda Atim
bio: Broadcast journalist with a national radio station, covering northern Uganda. Focused on community development and education stories.

name: Isaac Tumwine
bio: BArch Makerere University. Principal architect at a Kampala firm. Has designed several secondary school classroom blocks and health centres across central Uganda.

name: Miriam Nassuna
bio: Trained as a nurse in Uganda, then completed further studies in the UK. Works for the NHS in London. Active in the HOSA UK chapter and fundraising for school projects.

name: Robert Kigongo
bio: Among the first cohort of Highway Secondary School. Now a headteacher at a government-aided secondary school in Kassanda District. Deeply involved in HOSA's education committee.

name: Joan Tumusiime
bio: Completed ACCA after A-Level. Works in audit in Johannesburg. Runs a small scholarship fund for Highway students pursuing business studies.
